description: GPU Cluster Overview — total GPU health, alert summary, workload attribution and trend analysis for OpenShift + NVIDIA GPU Operator + DCGM Exporter

panels.title: Total GPU Count
panels.description: Total number of NVIDIA GPUs detected across all nodes via DCGM Exporter.

panels.title: Avg GPU Health Score
panels.description: Composite health (0–100), average of selected GPUs. Red <60 = GPUHealthScoreCritical; orange 60–80 = GPUHealthScoreHigh; green ≥80.

panels.title: Healthy GPUs (score ≥ 80)
panels.description: GPUs with a composite health score above 80 — operating normally.

panels.title: Warning GPUs (60–79)
panels.description: GPUs in the warning band (60–80). Investigate temperature, ECC or clock throttle.

panels.title: Critical GPUs (< 60)
panels.description: GPUs below health score 60 or with active predictive-failure alerts — require immediate attention.

panels.title: Failure risk > 30% (24h)
panels.description: GPUs with >30% predicted 24h failure probability — the cut-off WorkloadsOnAtRiskGPUNodes uses.

panels.title: VRAM Utilisation
panels.description: Avg GPU framebuffer memory used as % of total. Orange ≥80%, red ≥95%. High VRAM pressure causes workload OOM kills.

links.title: GPU SRE Deep Dive — memory panels

panels.title: Avg GPU Temp (°C)
panels.description: Orange ≥85°C matches GPUHighTemperatureSustained (>85°C). Red ≥90°C is near hardware slowdown.

panels.title: DCGM Targets Up
panels.description: Number of DCGM Exporter targets currently being scraped successfully by Prometheus.

links.title: All GPU Alerts — view all firing

panels.title: Total Firing GPU Alerts
panels.description: Total number of GPU alert rules currently in the Firing state.

panels.title: Critical Alerts
panels.description: Alerts at Severity=Critical — require immediate action.

panels.title: Warning Alerts
panels.description: Alerts at Severity=Warning — should be investigated promptly.

panels.title: Node Alerts
panels.description: Alerts scoped to a GPU worker node (e.g. node unreachable, DCGM darkout).

panels.title: Hardware Alerts
panels.description: Alerts scoped to a specific GPU device (e.g. row-remap failure, XID errors).

panels.title: Thermal / Power Alerts
panels.description: Thermal and power alerts: overheating, sustained throttling, power anomaly.

panels.title: Memory Alerts
panels.description: Memory alerts: ECC double-bit errors, row-remap failures, VRAM degradation.

panels.title: Predictive Alerts
panels.description: Predictive alerts: 24 h failure probability exceeded, composite health score low.

panels.title: Impact Alerts
panels.description: Workload-impact alerts: pods running on failed or at-risk GPU nodes.

links.title: Drill into GPU in SRE Dashboard
Open Grafana Alerting — all GPU alerts

panels.title: All Firing GPU Alerts
panels.description: Live table of all firing GPU alerts with rule name, severity, and labels.
Click any Node name (blue) to open the SRE Deep Dive dashboard scoped to that GPU. Sorted worst health first.
panels.title: Per-GPU Health Score, Failure Probability & VRAM
Row Remap FAILED — affected GPUs only
panels.description: Per-GPU row-remap failure flag. 1 = at least one uncorrectable row has been remapped — GPU may need replacement.

panels.title: Uncorrectable Remapped Rows — affected GPUs only
panels.description: Only GPUs with ≥1 uncorrectable remapped row (fires GPUDBERetiredPages, critical). Action: schedule GPU replacement.

panels.title: ╌ Workload Attribution — GPU Utilisation by Pod
GPU Utilisation by Workload — Namespace · Pod · Device
panels.description: GPU compute utilisation per consuming pod (DCGM exported_pod). Informational — high utilisation is not a fault.

panels.title: GPU Utilisation — All Devices
panels.description: GPU compute utilisation (%) time-series for every device. Hover for per-GPU breakdown.

panels.title: GPU Temperature — All Devices
panels.description: GPU core-die temperature (°C) per device over time. Sustained values above 85 °C trigger GPUOverheating alert.

panels.title: Power Draw — All Devices
panels.description: Instantaneous power draw (W) per device. Spikes or sustained drops may indicate power anomalies.

panels.title: Composite Health Score Trend
panels.description: Composite health score trend (0–100) per device over the selected time range.

panels.title: Pods on Failed GPU Nodes
panels.description: Pods on nodes with a failed row remap. >0 fires WorkloadsOnFailedGPUNodes (critical). Action: cordon/drain the node.

panels.title: Pods on At-Risk GPU Nodes (>30% 24h failure prob)
panels.description: Pods on nodes with a GPU above 30% 24h failure probability. >0 fires WorkloadsOnAtRiskGPUNodes (warning).

panels.title: DCGM Scrape Success
panels.description: Share of DCGM exporter targets scraping. <90% fires GPUDCGMScrapeDegraded.

panels.title: GPU Scoring & Alert Rules
panels.description: Are the gpu-alert-rules recording rules evaluating? NOT LOADED = health score, failure probability, impact counts and every platform=gpu-monitoring alert are not computed, so a 0 or empty value elsewhere does NOT mean healthy. Fix: oc apply -f gpu-rules.yaml.
